nom: Kate Somerville Liquid ExfoliKate Triple Acid Resurfacing Treatment

avis.texte: Full disclosure I'm very pleased with this product. Would give 4.5/5 stars. Here's where it loses a half point: this stuff smells STANKY, like spoiled milk/ferment. Eventually it dries down and gets covered up by your other skincare. I understand the formulation is naturally gonna smell that way so I'm not upset, it's just a mild setback for a good payoff. Overall it's a cop—maybe not the product to use before smooching up on your bae but definitely the product to use on your everything shower self-care night ;)

avis.titre: Hoping this will never be discontinued!!!...
avis.texte: This product is AMAZING! I have more mature skin that has gone from oily to dry. It's difficult to find products that won't create blemishes or don't dry out the face even more after the first week or so of use. Happily, that is not the case with this product. I do NOT apply this to a cotton round. Instead, I pour a few splashes on my fingers and QUICKLY apply all over as it dries VERY fast. It's true that not a lot comes out at one time, but I've found that three squirts will suffice to cover the face and upper neck. You only need a THIN layer. It does have an ever so slightly stickiness to it, but when you wake up your face will be as smooth as silk and no stickiness remains (also true if you apply it in the morning). I haven't noticed brightening, but it does have a tightening effect that you can definitely feel over, AND your skin will have that perfect glass appearance. NO breakouts. NO pilling. NO irritation. What can I say? IT IS FABULOUS!!!

This is the next best thing to a retinoid. Ive used it for 2 weeks now, twice a week and such a HUGE difference. I have an expensive lactic acid serum that im thinking about discontinuing because i now have this and its much more cheaper. It buffs my skin and leaves it looking brighter. I suggest this for someone who has dry skin.
